lines.text: What if you woke up tomorrow and realised that today had happened before?
And tomorrow... would never come.
A young man wakes up, gets ready for work, drinks his coffee and leaves his apartment.
Everything seems normal.
Until he notices the same accident happening at the same intersection.
The same car. The same pedestrian. The same broken traffic light.
He begins to feel that something is terribly wrong.
The next morning, he wakes up again.
The exact same date.
The same phone notification. The same breakfast. The same accident.
He tries everything to change the day.
He stays home, takes a different route and even refuses to sleep.
But no matter what he does, midnight arrives...
And the day resets.
After what feels like hundreds of identical days, he discovers something terrifying.
Every time the clock reaches midnight, the entire world resets.
Except one thing.
A small photograph on his bedroom wall.
With every reset, another person disappears from it.
On the final photograph, only one person remains.
Himself.
He finally understands.
This isn't a time loop designed to trap him.
It's a countdown.
And when the last person disappears...
There will be nothing left to reset.
But the strangest part?
The clock strikes midnight.
And for the first time...
It keeps moving.
